## omnifeed v0.29.0

Self-hosted web search (SearXNG) + LLM-friendly crawling with a dedicated Reddit engine — MCP server, Open WebUI compatible.

## Changelog
### 🎉 Features
* 54ac073037b00b9cf1c88958c3dc0149fd628043 feat(httpx): honour the search concurrency cap without Redis
### Other changes
* a292776624a20b8b4cba00f86439d9b7a3481097 chore(release): v0.29.0 [skip ci]
* bf6acdb375d7b28255bfce448b645902aab5fcf3 chore(stack): size the crawl4ai pool and drop a dead env var

## Docker

```
docker pull kinorai/omnifeed:0.29.0
```

## Verify

The `checksums.txt` file contains SHA-256 hashes for every artifact in this release.
name: v0.29.0
